+    period = None
+    for p in range(1, max(h, w) + 1):
+        groups = {}
+        valid = True
+        for d, values in observed.items():
+            key = d % p
+            if key in groups and groups[key] != values:
+                valid = False

+            groups[key] = values
+        if valid:

+            break
+    if period is None:

+    motif = {}
+    for d, values in observed.items():

+    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

+        for c in range(w):
+            if out[r][c] == 0 and (c - r) % period in motif:
